{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Infobox Item |name = Uncut diamond |image = [[File:Uncut diamond.png]] |release = [[17 March]] [[2001]] |update = This weeks update |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = This would be worth more cut. |value = 200 |weight = 0.003 |exchange = Yes |id = 1617 }} [[File:Uncut diamond detail.png|left|130px]] An '''uncut diamond''' is a precious [[gem]] used in [[Crafting]]. It can be cut with a [[chisel]] to make a [[diamond]], requiring 43 Crafting and yielding 107.5 [[experience]]. Uncut diamonds can be obtained in several ways: randomly while [[mining]] [[ore]]s, as drops from [[monster]]s (mainly those which have access to the [[rare drop table]]), [[gem shop]]s, or as a reward from certain [[minigames]] and [[random events]]. They are also a common reward from [[Managing Miscellania]]. With level 40 [[Mining]] and the quest [[Shilo Village]] completed, players can mine the [[gem rocks]] in [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]. Gem rocks may also appear while playing the [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] activity, where players can mine them 3 times. Another method to get uncut diamonds is by cracking [[Wall safe (lobby)|wall safes]] in the [[Rogues' Den]], but this requires level 50 [[Thieving]]. An uncut diamond is a reward from the [[Troll Romance]] quest and is dropped by the [[Slagilith]] during [[One Small Favour]]. ==Training== ===Crafting=== {|class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: center;" !{{SCP|Crafting}} Level !Input !Material Cost{{Refn|Cost calculated assuming all inputs are purchased from the [[Grand Exchange]].|group=t}} !Output !Sell Price !Profit / loss !{{SCP|Crafting}} XP/Craft !XP/Hour !Coins/XP |- |43 |{{plink|Uncut diamond}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Uncut diamond}}}} |{{plink|Diamond}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Diamond}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Diamond}}-{{GEP|Uncut diamond}}}} |107.5 |311,750{{Refn|XP rates based on an assumed 2,900 cuts per hour|group=t}} |{{Coins|({{GEP|Diamond}}-{{GEP|Uncut diamond}})/107.5}} |} {{Reflist|group=t}} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Uncut diamond}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Uncut diamond}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Uncut diamond}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 6 August 2007 |update = Clan Chat |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |date = |update = |change = Gems available on [[free-to-play]] worlds can no longer be crushed with a [[hammer]] to receive a [[members object]] ([[crushed gem]]). }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Uncut diamond detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Uncut diamond detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Uncut diamond detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Uncut diamond (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Uncut diamond (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Uncut diamond.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
